newsitem.title: USA: First Patriot to explore share enhancement.
newsitem.headline: First Patriot to explore share enhancement.

text.p: First Patriot Bankshares Corp said Friday it had formed a committee to explore methods of enhancing shareholder value and perhaps make recommendations to the board.
The company said the committee has engaged the investment banking firm of Baxter Fentriss and Co to assist the committee in identifying and assessing alternative value enhancement strategies.
The company said the committee hopes to complete its study by the end of 1996.
